payload.name: Preserve All Listed Items in Offer Enumerations
payload.description: Use during extraction when a message lists multiple services, offerings, or coordinated items a person provides; apply before finalizing a candidate.
content: During extraction, when a speaker enumerates two or more services, offerings, or components in a single statement (e.g., 'mentoring and training'), include every listed item in the memory candidate; do not drop one element when paraphrasing.
If a coordinated pair is expressed with 'and' or a list, treat each element as an explicit fact; a summary such as 'mentoring' for 'mentoring and training' loses information.
Stop after capturing all explicitly listed items; do not add services or components the speaker did not mention.

solves: Extraction from an offer or service description often drops one item when a message lists multiple coordinated services; the resulting memory is incomplete and cannot support later questions about what is offered.
